items.title: Musk Targets Starlink in All Tesla Models “Towards the End of Next Year.” China Is the Catch
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said he hopes a built-in Starlink option reaches all Tesla models toward the end of 2027, except in China, where he says Starlink is illegal. The connection matters most for Tesla’s robotaxis, and Tesla would buy it from SpaceX, which runs Starlink.
